identity.name: Dhaka Tribune
identity.description: A Bangladeshi English-language daily and digital publisher covering politics, business, society and culture, with a sister Bengali site.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Published by 2A Media Limited and associated with Gemcon Group; publisher Kazi Anis Ahmed. Commercial ownership with a liberal, urban readership.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Commercial newsroom with plural opinion and bylined reporting; no evidence of direct state control.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via secondary references (official about page blocked or unavailable); secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: Generally liberal-centrist and urban in outlook; no external rating identified.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Business coverage is descriptive and development-oriented, without a strong ideological line.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: Frames national politics through governance, business and civil-society perspectives.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Established English-language daily with bylined reporting and corrections; no external MBFC rating.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No MBFC rating identified. Reliability assessed from institutional record and feed sample.

intelligence.knownPerspective: Bangladeshi urban-liberal newspaper voice. Covers politics and business with a relatively plural op-ed mix and a less confrontational tone than the Daily Star.

selectionRationale: Provides a second Bangladeshi English-language perspective, reducing dependence on a single national outlet.

research.researchNotes: Official About page returned 404; ownership verified through secondary references and feed metadata. Existing production mapping retained. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
